invariants.name: zero bar floor
enforces: layoutColumns renders zero as a stub and enforces a 3% floor

invariants.name: null spotify view
enforces: spotifyView returns null without an overview

invariants.name: zero total
enforces: tierCards guards missing data and a zero total

invariants.name: one headline size
enforces: every data tile headline takes its size from HEADLINE

invariants.name: every workout type
enforces: breakdownColumns keeps every workout type once, in count order

invariants.name: empty breakdown
enforces: breakdownColumns handles an empty breakdown

invariants.name: waka missing sources
enforces: mapWakaStats tolerates missing sources

invariants.name: trakt missing sources
enforces: mapTraktStats tolerates missing or malformed sources

invariants.name: tier order
enforces: TIERS run hot to cold with one hue each

invariants.name: year captions
enforces: spotifyView captions hours and marks the unfinished last year so far

invariants.name: zero percent
enforces: pct rounds and guards a zero total

invariants.name: no zero peak
enforces: layoutColumns with all zeros has no peak
